## Overview

This folder contains two categories of content:

1. **TOGAF-aligned Reference Architecture Documents (RADs)** — Phase C–D outputs that provide illustrative implementation patterns for the Component ABBs in the Cloud and Infrastructure Security domain
2. **Pre-existing Solution Building Block (SBB) documents** — implementation-level documents that pre-date the TOGAF-aligned structure; retained as implementation reference material

## Pre-existing SBB Documents

These documents were created prior to the TOGAF-aligned domain structure. They are retained as implementation reference material. They are not normative ABBs and do not carry SHALL/SHOULD language.

| Document | Description | Note |
|---|---|---|
| [GUID-SEC-CLOUD-AWS-2.6.01](GUID-SEC-CLOUD-AWS-2.6.01.md) | AWS-specific cloud security implementation reference | SBB-level content; consult the governing Component ABBs for normative requirements |
| [GUID-SEC-CLOUD-DMZ-2.6.02](GUID-SEC-CLOUD-DMZ-2.6.02.md) | AWS DMZ architecture implementation reference | SBB-level content; network architecture design authority is [GUID-SEC-NETWORK-CLOUD-NET-2.2.11](../../Network/GUID-SEC-NETWORK-CLOUD-NET-2.2.11.md) |
